items.prompt:
A text that tells history year by year uses which structure?
A) chronological
B) compare and contrast
C) problem and solution

A text that states a problem and then how to fix it uses:
A) problem and solution
B) chronological
C) description

A text comparing a cat and a dog uses:
A) compare and contrast
B) sequence
C) cause and effect

Text A lists the history of cars by year; Text B explains why cars pollute and how to fix it. Their structures are:
A) both chronological
B) chronological and problem/solution
C) both compare/contrast

Which signal words show CAUSE and EFFECT?
A) because, so, as a result
B) first, next
C) alike, but
items.answer: A) because, so, as a result

solution.answer: A) because, so, as a result

items.prompt:
Recognizing a text's structure helps you:
A) follow and understand its ideas
B) count the pages
C) pick the font
items.answer: A) follow and understand its ideas

steps: Structure aids comprehension. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) follow and understand its ideas

items.prompt:
Two texts about plastic in the ocean: Text A compares plastic to natural materials; Text B explains the problem and describes clean-up solutions. The DIFFERENCE in structure is:
A) compare/contrast vs problem/solution
B) both are chronological
C) there is no difference

A text begins 'In 1920...', then '1935...', then '1950...'. Its structure is:
A) chronological
B) compare and contrast
C) problem and solution

steps: Dates in order. Key is A.
